meaningEn: the work steps are clear

sentences.hanzi: 只要作业步骤明确，执行起来就不会手忙脚乱。
sentences.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 zuo4 ye4 bu4 zhou4 ming2 que4, zhi2 xing2 qi3 lai2 jiu4 bu2 hui4 shou3 mang2 jiao3 luan4.
sentences.meaningKo: 작업 단계만 명확하면 실행할 때 허둥대지 않게 된다.
sentences.meaningEn: As long as the work steps are clear, people will not become flustered when carrying them out.

meaningEn: after giving a response

sentences.hanzi: 他做出回应之后，现场的紧张气氛缓和了不少。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zuo4 chu1 hui2 ying4 zhi1 hou4, xian4 chang3 de5 jin3 zhang1 qi4 fen1 huan3 he2 le5 bu4 shao3.
sentences.meaningKo: 그가 응답한 뒤 현장의 긴장된 분위기가 꽤 누그러졌다.
sentences.meaningEn: After he gave a response, the tense atmosphere on site eased considerably.

meaningEn: team members give timely feedback

sentences.hanzi: 只要组员及时反馈，很多问题都能尽早发现。
sentences.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 zu3 yuan2 ji2 shi2 fan3 kui4, hen3 duo1 wen4 ti2 dou1 neng2 jin3 zao3 fa1 xian4.
sentences.meaningKo: 조원들이 제때 피드백하기만 하면 많은 문제를 일찍 발견할 수 있다.
sentences.meaningEn: As long as team members give timely feedback, many problems can be discovered early.

meaningEn: to sit on one side and listen

sentences.hanzi: 你先坐在一旁听，熟悉以后再参与讨论。
sentences.pinyin: ni3 xian1 zuo4 zai4 yi4 pang2 ting1, shu2 xi1 yi3 hou4 zai4 can1 yu4 tao3 lun4.
sentences.meaningKo: 너는 먼저 한쪽에 앉아 듣고 익숙해진 뒤에 토론에 참여해라.
sentences.meaningEn: Sit on one side and listen first, and join the discussion after you become familiar with it.

meaningEn: the compositional thinking is mature

sentences.hanzi: 经过系统训练以后，他的作曲思维已经很成熟了。
sentences.pinyin: jing1 guo4 xi4 tong3 xun4 lian4 yi3 hou4, ta1 de5 zuo4 qu3 si1 wei2 yi3 jing1 hen3 cheng2 shu2 le5.
sentences.meaningKo: 체계적인 훈련을 거친 뒤 그의 작곡 사고는 이미 매우 성숙해졌다.
sentences.meaningEn: After systematic training, his compositional thinking has become very mature.

meaningEn: to emphasize logic in doing things

sentences.hanzi: 处理复杂问题时，做事一定要讲逻辑。
sentences.pinyin: chu3 li3 fu4 za2 wen4 ti2 shi2, zuo4 shi4 yi2 ding4 yao4 jiang3 luo2 ji2.
sentences.meaningKo: 복잡한 문제를 처리할 때는 일을 하면서 반드시 논리를 중시해야 한다.
sentences.meaningEn: When dealing with complex problems, one must emphasize logic in doing things.

meaningEn: the workflow connection is clear

sentences.hanzi: 前后作业衔接清楚，执行时就不会容易出错。
sentences.pinyin: qian2 hou4 zuo4 ye4 xian2 jie1 qing1 chu3, zhi2 xing2 shi2 jiu4 bu2 hui4 rong2 yi4 chu1 cuo4.
sentences.meaningKo: 앞뒤 작업 연계가 분명하면 실행할 때 쉽게 실수하지 않는다.
sentences.meaningEn: When the workflow connection between stages is clear, mistakes are less likely during execution.

meaningEn: to sit and wait for the next round

sentences.hanzi: 大家先坐着等下一轮安排，不要着急。
sentences.pinyin: da4 jia1 xian1 zuo4 zhe5 deng3 xia4 yi4 lun2 an1 pai2, bu2 yao4 zhao2 ji2.
sentences.meaningKo: 모두 먼저 앉아서 다음 차례 배치를 기다리고 조급해하지 마라.
sentences.meaningEn: Everyone should sit and wait for the arrangements for the next round, and not be anxious.

meaningEn: the group leader coordinates the work in a unified way

sentences.hanzi: 涉及多个部门时，最好由组长统一协调工作。
sentences.pinyin: she4 ji2 duo1 ge4 bu4 men2 shi2, zui4 hao3 you2 zu3 zhang3 tong3 yi1 xie2 tiao2 gong1 zuo4.
sentences.meaningKo: 여러 부서가 관련될 때는 조장이 업무를 통일적으로 조정하는 것이 가장 좋다.
sentences.meaningEn: When multiple departments are involved, it is best for the group leader to coordinate the work in a unified way.

meaningEn: to be very measured in doing things
meaningKo: 일할 때 매우 적절한 선을 안다

sentences.hanzi: 他做事很有分寸，所以很少让人感到为难。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zuo4 shi4 hen3 you3 fen4 cun4, suo3 yi3 hen3 shao3 rang4 ren2 gan3 dao4 wei2 nan2.
sentences.meaningKo: 그는 일할 때 매우 적절한 선을 알아서 남을 난처하게 만드는 일이 드물다.
sentences.meaningEn: He is very measured in doing things, so he rarely makes others feel uncomfortable.

meaningEn: the answer is well-organized and clear

sentences.hanzi: 只要作答条理清楚，阅卷老师就更容易抓到重点。
sentences.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 zuo4 da2 tiao2 li3 qing1 chu3, yue4 juan4 lao3 shi1 jiu4 geng4 rong2 yi4 zhua1 dao4 zhong4 dian3.
sentences.meaningKo: 답안의 조리만 분명하면 채점 선생님이 핵심을 더 쉽게 파악할 수 있다.
sentences.meaningEn: As long as the answer is well-organized and clear, the grader can grasp the key points more easily.

meaningEn: the composition has clearly defined layers

sentences.hanzi: 这首作品作曲层次分明，听起来很有立体感。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 shou3 zuo4 pin3 zuo4 qu3 ceng2 ci4 fen1 ming2, ting1 qi3 lai2 hen3 you3 li4 ti3 gan3.
sentences.meaningKo: 이 작품은 작곡의 층위가 분명해서 들으면 입체감이 크다.
sentences.meaningEn: This piece has clearly defined compositional layers, giving it a strong sense of depth when heard.

meaningEn: to sit and wait for the teacher's arrangements

sentences.hanzi: 大家先坐着等老师安排，不要自己乱动。
sentences.pinyin: da4 jia1 xian1 zuo4 zhe5 deng3 lao3 shi1 an1 pai2, bu2 yao4 zi4 ji3 luan4 dong4.
sentences.meaningKo: 모두 먼저 앉아서 선생님의 배치를 기다리고 제멋대로 움직이지 마라.
sentences.meaningEn: Everyone should sit and wait for the teacher’s arrangements first, and not move about on their own.

meaningEn: the group leader explains the key points of the task

sentences.hanzi: 开始之前，组长先说明了任务重点。
sentences.pinyin: kai1 shi3 zhi1 qian2, zu3 zhang3 xian1 shuo1 ming2 le5 ren4 wu5 zhong4 dian3.
sentences.meaningKo: 시작하기 전에 조장이 먼저 임무의 핵심을 설명했다.
sentences.meaningEn: Before starting, the group leader first explained the key points of the task.

meaningEn: to have a division of labor in doing things

sentences.hanzi: 做事有分工，效率往往会提高很多。
sentences.pinyin: zuo4 shi4 you3 fen1 gong1, xiao4 lv4 wang3 wang3 hui4 ti2 gao1 hen3 duo1.
sentences.meaningKo: 일할 때 역할 분담이 있으면 효율은 대개 훨씬 높아진다.
sentences.meaningEn: When there is a division of labor in doing things, efficiency often improves a lot.

meaningEn: the work arrangement is clear

sentences.hanzi: 只要作业安排清楚，大家就知道该先做什么。
sentences.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 zuo4 ye4 an1 pai2 qing1 chu3, da4 jia1 jiu4 zhi1 dao4 gai1 xian1 zuo4 shen2 me5.
sentences.meaningKo: 작업 배치만 분명하면 모두가 무엇을 먼저 해야 하는지 알게 된다.
sentences.meaningEn: As long as the work arrangement is clear, everyone will know what should be done first.

meaningEn: to sit and listen to the teacher speak

sentences.hanzi: 大家安静地坐着听老师讲，不要随便插话。
sentences.pinyin: da4 jia1 an1 jing4 di5 zuo4 zhe5 ting1 lao3 shi1 jiang3, bu2 yao4 sui2 bian4 cha1 hua4.
sentences.meaningKo: 모두 조용히 앉아서 선생님 말씀을 듣고 함부로 끼어들지 마라.
sentences.meaningEn: Everyone should sit quietly and listen to the teacher speak, and not interrupt casually.

meaningEn: the group leader explains in advance

sentences.hanzi: 为了避免误会，组长提前把情况说明清楚了。
sentences.pinyin: wei4 le5 bi4 mian3 wu4 hui4, zu3 zhang3 ti2 qian2 ba3 qing2 kuang4 shuo1 ming2 qing1 chu3 le5.
sentences.meaningKo: 오해를 피하기 위해 조장이 미리 상황을 분명히 설명해 두었다.
sentences.meaningEn: To avoid misunderstanding, the group leader explained the situation clearly in advance.

meaningEn: to have key priorities in doing things

sentences.hanzi: 做事有重点，推进起来才不会东一榔头西一棒子。
sentences.pinyin: zuo4 shi4 you3 zhong4 dian3, tui1 jin4 qi3 lai2 cai2 bu2 hui4 dong1 yi4 lang2 tou5 xi1 yi2 bang4 zi5.
sentences.meaningKo: 일할 때 중점이 있어야 추진할 때 갈피를 못 잡고 헤매지 않는다.
sentences.meaningEn: Only when there are clear priorities in doing things will progress not become scattered and unfocused.

meaningEn: adjustment of the work scope

sentences.hanzi: 根据实际情况，我们对作业范围做了调整。
sentences.pinyin: gen1 ju4 shi2 ji4 qing2 kuang4, wo3 men5 dui4 zuo4 ye4 fan4 wei2 zuo4 le5 tiao2 zheng3.
sentences.meaningKo: 실제 상황에 따라 우리는 작업 범위를 조정했다.
sentences.meaningEn: According to the actual situation, we adjusted the work scope.

meaningEn: to sit and wait until the explanation is finished

sentences.hanzi: 大家先坐着等讲完，再开始提问题。
sentences.pinyin: da4 jia1 xian1 zuo4 zhe5 deng3 jiang3 wan2, zai4 kai1 shi3 ti2 wen4 ti2.
sentences.meaningKo: 모두 먼저 앉아서 설명이 끝나기를 기다린 뒤 질문을 시작하자.
sentences.meaningEn: Everyone should first sit and wait until the explanation is finished, and then begin asking questions.

meaningEn: the group leader explains the division of labor

sentences.hanzi: 开始之前，先由组长说明这次的分工安排。
sentences.pinyin: kai1 shi3 zhi1 qian2, xian1 you2 zu3 zhang3 shuo1 ming2 zhe4 ci4 de5 fen1 gong1 an1 pai2.
sentences.meaningKo: 시작하기 전에 먼저 조장이 이번 역할 분담 배치를 설명한다.
sentences.meaningEn: Before starting, the group leader first explains the division-of-labor arrangements for this time.

meaningEn: to have a sense of direction in doing things

sentences.hanzi: 目标清楚以后，做事自然就会更有方向感。
sentences.pinyin: mu4 biao1 qing1 chu3 yi3 hou4, zuo4 shi4 zi4 ran2 jiu4 hui4 geng4 you3 fang1 xiang4 gan3.
sentences.meaningKo: 목표가 분명해지면 일을 할 때 자연히 더 방향감이 생긴다.
sentences.meaningEn: Once the goal is clear, one naturally has a better sense of direction in doing things.

meaningEn: the work plan is clear

sentences.hanzi: 只要作业计划清楚，后面的配合就会顺利很多。
sentences.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 zuo4 ye4 ji4 hua4 qing1 chu3, hou4 mian4 de5 pei4 he2 jiu4 hui4 shun4 li4 hen3 duo1.
sentences.meaningKo: 작업 계획만 분명하면 이후 협력은 훨씬 순조로워진다.
sentences.meaningEn: As long as the work plan is clear, later cooperation becomes much smoother.

meaningEn: to sit and wait for class to begin

sentences.hanzi: 大家先坐着等上课，不要在教室里大声说话。
sentences.pinyin: da4 jia1 xian1 zuo4 zhe5 deng3 shang4 ke4, bu2 yao4 zai4 jiao4 shi4 li3 da4 sheng1 shuo1 hua4.
sentences.meaningKo: 모두 먼저 앉아서 수업 시작을 기다리고 교실 안에서 큰 소리로 말하지 마라.
sentences.meaningEn: Everyone should sit and wait for class to begin, and not speak loudly in the classroom.

meaningEn: the group leader explains the arrangements clearly

sentences.hanzi: 只要组长把安排讲清，后面的执行就简单多了。
sentences.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 zu3 zhang3 ba3 an1 pai2 jiang3 qing1, hou4 mian4 de5 zhi2 xing2 jiu4 jian3 dan1 duo1 le5.
sentences.meaningKo: 조장이 배치를 분명히 설명하기만 하면 이후 실행은 훨씬 단순해진다.
sentences.meaningEn: As long as the group leader explains the arrangements clearly, the later execution becomes much simpler.

meaningEn: to do things in a disciplined and rule-based way

sentences.hanzi: 他做事有规矩，所以大家都愿意跟着他做。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zuo4 shi4 you3 gui1 ju3, suo3 yi3 da4 jia1 dou1 yuan4 yi4 gen1 zhe5 ta1 zuo4.
sentences.meaningKo: 그는 일할 때 규칙이 있어서 모두가 기꺼이 그를 따라 일한다.
sentences.meaningEn: He does things in a disciplined way, so everyone is willing to follow his lead.

meaningEn: the workflow is stable

sentences.hanzi: 只要作业流程稳定，整体效率就容易保持。
sentences.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 zuo4 ye4 liu2 cheng2 wen3 ding4, zheng3 ti3 xiao4 lv4 jiu4 rong2 yi4 bao3 chi2.
sentences.meaningKo: 작업 절차만 안정적이면 전체 효율을 유지하기 쉬워진다.
sentences.meaningEn: As long as the workflow is stable, it is easier to maintain overall efficiency.

meaningEn: to sit and listen to task assignment/instructions

sentences.hanzi: 大家先坐着听布置，听完以后再分头去准备。
sentences.pinyin: da4 jia1 xian1 zuo4 zhe5 ting1 bu4 zhi4, ting1 wan2 yi3 hou4 zai4 fen1 tou2 qu4 zhun3 bei4.
sentences.meaningKo: 모두 먼저 앉아서 지시를 듣고 다 들은 뒤에 나누어 준비하러 가자.
sentences.meaningEn: Everyone should first sit and listen to the instructions, and after hearing them all, split up and go prepare.

meaningEn: the group leader arranges the process in a unified way

sentences.hanzi: 为了保证效率，这次由组长统一安排流程。
sentences.pinyin: wei4 le5 bao3 zheng4 xiao4 lv4, zhe4 ci4 you2 zu3 zhang3 tong3 yi1 an1 pai2 liu2 cheng2.
sentences.meaningKo: 효율을 보장하기 위해 이번에는 조장이 절차를 통일적으로 배치한다.
sentences.meaningEn: To ensure efficiency, this time the group leader arranges the process in a unified way.

meaningEn: the key points of the work stand out clearly

sentences.hanzi: 只要作业重点突出，汇报时就更容易让人抓住核心。
sentences.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 zuo4 ye4 zhong4 dian3 tu1 chu1, hui4 bao4 shi2 jiu4 geng4 rong2 yi4 rang4 ren2 zhua1 zhu4 he2 xin1.
sentences.meaningKo: 작업 중점이 두드러지기만 하면 보고할 때 사람들이 핵심을 더 쉽게 파악할 수 있다.
sentences.meaningEn: As long as the key points of the work stand out clearly, it becomes easier for people to grasp the core during the report.

meaningEn: after making a supplement

sentences.hanzi: 他做出补充后，原来的方案就显得更完整了。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zuo4 chu1 bu3 chong1 hou4, yuan2 lai2 de5 fang1 an4 jiu4 xian3 de5 geng4 wan2 zheng3 le5.
sentences.meaningKo: 그가 보충한 뒤 원래의 방안은 더욱 완전해 보이게 되었다.
sentences.meaningEn: After he made a supplement, the original plan appeared more complete.

meaningEn: team members maintain communication

sentences.hanzi: 只要组员保持沟通，很多误会都可以提前避免。
sentences.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 zu3 yuan2 bao3 chi2 gou1 tong1, hen3 duo1 wu4 hui4 dou1 ke3 yi3 ti2 qian2 bi4 mian3.
sentences.meaningKo: 조원들이 소통을 유지하기만 하면 많은 오해를 미리 피할 수 있다.
sentences.meaningEn: As long as team members maintain communication, many misunderstandings can be avoided in advance.

meaningEn: to sit in the middle

sentences.hanzi: 他喜欢坐在中间，这样看屏幕最方便。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 xi3 huan1 zuo4 zai4 zhong1 jian1, zhe4 yang4 kan4 ping2 mu4 zui4 fang1 bian4.
sentences.meaningKo: 그는 가운데에 앉는 것을 좋아하는데, 그러면 화면을 보기가 가장 편하다.
sentences.meaningEn: He likes to sit in the middle, because that makes it the most convenient to see the screen.

meaningEn: the compositional direction is clear

sentences.hanzi: 只要作曲方向清楚，后面的细节就更容易展开。
sentences.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 zuo4 qu3 fang1 xiang4 qing1 chu3, hou4 mian4 de5 xi4 jie2 jiu4 geng4 rong2 yi4 zhan3 kai1.
sentences.meaningKo: 작곡 방향만 분명하면 이후의 세부도 더 쉽게 전개할 수 있다.
sentences.meaningEn: As long as the compositional direction is clear, the later details can be developed more easily.

meaningEn: to emphasize a sense of efficiency in doing things

sentences.hanzi: 时间紧的时候，做事尤其要讲效率感。
sentences.pinyin: shi2 jian1 jin3 de5 shi2 hou4, zuo4 shi4 you2 qi2 yao4 jiang3 xiao4 lv4 gan3.
sentences.meaningKo: 시간이 촉박할 때는 일을 하면서 특히 효율 감각을 중시해야 한다.
sentences.meaningEn: When time is tight, one should especially emphasize a sense of efficiency in doing things.

meaningEn: the work content is clear

sentences.hanzi: 只要作业内容清楚，执行时就不容易跑偏。
sentences.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 zuo4 ye4 nei4 rong2 qing1 chu3, zhi2 xing2 shi2 jiu4 bu4 rong2 yi4 pao3 pian1.
sentences.meaningKo: 작업 내용만 분명하면 실행할 때 쉽게 빗나가지 않는다.
sentences.meaningEn: As long as the work content is clear, it is not easy to go off track during execution.

meaningEn: to sit and wait until the announcement/notice ends

sentences.hanzi: 大家先坐着等通知结束，再开始各自准备。
sentences.pinyin: da4 jia1 xian1 zuo4 zhe5 deng3 tong1 zhi1 jie2 shu4, zai4 kai1 shi3 ge4 zi4 zhun3 bei4.
sentences.meaningKo: 모두 먼저 앉아서 공지가 끝나기를 기다린 뒤 각자 준비를 시작하자.
sentences.meaningEn: Everyone should first sit and wait until the announcement ends, and then begin preparing individually.

meaningEn: the group leader explains the situation in a unified way

sentences.hanzi: 为了避免信息混乱，先由组长统一说明情况。
sentences.pinyin: wei4 le5 bi4 mian3 xin4 xi1 hun4 luan4, xian1 you2 zu3 zhang3 tong3 yi1 shuo1 ming2 qing2 kuang4.
sentences.meaningKo: 정보 혼란을 피하기 위해 먼저 조장이 상황을 통일적으로 설명한다.
sentences.meaningEn: To avoid information confusion, the group leader first explains the situation in a unified way.

meaningEn: to be very patient in doing things

sentences.hanzi: 她做事很有耐心，所以复杂的细节也处理得很好。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zuo4 shi4 hen3 you3 nai4 xin1, suo3 yi3 fu4 za2 de5 xi4 jie2 ye3 chu3 li3 de5 hen3 hao3.
sentences.meaningKo: 그녀는 일할 때 매우 인내심이 있어서 복잡한 세부도 아주 잘 처리한다.
sentences.meaningEn: She is very patient in doing things, so even complex details are handled very well.

meaningEn: the answering requirements are clear

sentences.hanzi: 只要作答要求清楚，学生就知道该怎么下笔。
sentences.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 zuo4 da2 yao1 qiu2 qing1 chu3, xue2 sheng1 jiu4 zhi1 dao4 gai1 zen3 me5 xia4 bi3.
sentences.meaningKo: 답안 요구 사항만 분명하면 학생들은 어떻게 써야 할지 알게 된다.
sentences.meaningEn: As long as the answering requirements are clear, students will know how to begin writing.

meaningEn: the composition structure is clear

sentences.hanzi: 这首作品作曲结构清晰，听众很容易跟上。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 shou3 zuo4 pin3 zuo4 qu3 jie2 gou4 qing1 xi1, ting1 zhong4 hen3 rong2 yi4 gen1 shang4.
sentences.meaningKo: 이 작품은 작곡 구조가 명확해서 청중이 따라가기 쉽다.
sentences.meaningEn: This piece has a clear compositional structure, so the audience can follow it easily.

meaningEn: to sit and listen to the explanation of arrangements

sentences.hanzi: 大家先坐着听安排说明，明白以后再行动。

sentences.pinyin: da4 jia1 xian1 zuo4 zhe5 ting1 tong1 zhi1, ting1 wan2 yi3 hou4 zai4 li2 kai1.
sentences.meaningKo: 모두 먼저 앉아서 공지를 듣고 다 들은 뒤에 떠나라.
sentences.meaningEn: Everyone should first sit and listen to the notice, and leave after hearing it all.

meaningEn: the group leader gives a unified explanation

sentences.hanzi: 为了让大家理解一致，先由组长统一讲解。
sentences.pinyin: wei4 le5 rang4 da4 jia1 li3 jie3 yi2 zhi4, xian1 you2 zu3 zhang3 tong3 yi1 jiang3 jie3.
sentences.meaningKo: 모두의 이해를 일치시키기 위해 먼저 조장이 통일적으로 해설한다.
sentences.meaningEn: To make everyone’s understanding consistent, the group leader first gives a unified explanation.

meaningEn: to have a good sense of method in doing things

sentences.hanzi: 他做事有方法感，所以总能找到更省力的办法。

sentences.meaningKo: 그는 일할 때 방법 감각이 있어서 늘 더 수월한 방법을 찾아낸다.
sentences.meaningEn: He has a good sense of method in doing things, so he can always find a more efficient way.

meaningEn: the work objective is stable

sentences.hanzi: 只要作业目标稳定，团队就不会轻易动摇。
sentences.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 zuo4 ye4 mu4 biao1 wen3 ding4, tuan2 dui4 jiu4 bu2 hui4 qing1 yi4 dong4 yao2.
sentences.meaningKo: 작업 목표만 안정적이면 팀은 쉽게 흔들리지 않는다.
sentences.meaningEn: As long as the work objective is stable, the team will not be easily shaken.

meaningEn: to sit and listen to the notice to the end

sentences.hanzi: 大家先坐着听完通知，再决定要不要提问。
sentences.pinyin: da4 jia1 xian1 zuo4 zhe5 ting1 wan2 tong1 zhi1, zai4 jue2 ding4 yao4 bu2 yao4 ti2 wen4.
sentences.meaningKo: 모두 먼저 앉아서 공지를 끝까지 듣고 그다음 질문할지 결정하자.
sentences.meaningEn: Everyone should first sit and listen to the notice to the end, and then decide whether to ask questions.

meaningEn: the group leader's arrangements are organized

sentences.hanzi: 这次活动之所以顺利，是因为组长安排得很有条理。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 ci4 huo2 dong4 zhi1 suo3 yi3 shun4 li4, shi4 yin1 wei4 zu3 zhang3 an1 pai2 de5 hen3 you3 tiao2 li3.

sentences.meaningEn: The reason this activity went smoothly is that the group leader’s arrangements were very well organized.

meaningEn: the work structure is clear

sentences.hanzi: 只要作业结构清楚，后面的汇报就会更容易展开。
sentences.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 zuo4 ye4 jie2 gou4 qing1 chu3, hou4 mian4 de5 hui4 bao4 jiu4 hui4 geng4 rong2 yi4 zhan3 kai1.
sentences.meaningKo: 작업 구조만 분명하면 이후 보고도 훨씬 쉽게 전개된다.
sentences.meaningEn: As long as the work structure is clear, the later report will be much easier to develop.

meaningEn: after making revisions

sentences.hanzi: 做出修改后，这份报告看起来完整多了。
sentences.pinyin: zuo4 chu1 xiu1 gai3 hou4, zhe4 fen4 bao4 gao4 kan4 qi3 lai2 wan2 zheng3 duo1 le5.
sentences.meaningKo: 수정한 뒤 이 보고서는 훨씬 더 완전해 보이게 되었다.
sentences.meaningEn: After making revisions, this report looked much more complete.

meaningEn: team members communicate in a timely manner

sentences.hanzi: 只要组员及时沟通，很多问题都不会拖到最后。
sentences.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 zu3 yuan2 ji2 shi2 gou1 tong1, hen3 duo1 wen4 ti2 dou1 bu2 hui4 tuo1 dao4 zui4 hou4.
sentences.meaningKo: 조원들이 제때 소통하기만 하면 많은 문제가 마지막까지 끌리지 않는다.
sentences.meaningEn: As long as team members communicate in a timely manner, many problems will not be dragged to the end.

meaningEn: to sit in the back and listen

sentences.hanzi: 他今天坐在后面听，一直没有发言。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 jin1 tian1 zuo4 zai4 hou4 mian4 ting1, yi4 zhi2 mei2 you3 fa1 yan2.
sentences.meaningKo: 그는 오늘 뒤에 앉아 듣기만 했고 계속 발언하지 않았다.
sentences.meaningEn: He sat in the back and listened today, and did not speak the whole time.

meaningEn: the compositional theme is clear

sentences.hanzi: 这首作品作曲主题明确，一开始就能抓住听众。

sentences.meaningEn: This piece has a clear compositional theme and can capture the audience right from the beginning.

meaningEn: to emphasize steps in doing things

sentences.hanzi: 新手做事更要讲步骤，不能一下子全乱了。
sentences.pinyin: xin1 shou3 zuo4 shi4 geng4 yao4 jiang3 bu4 zhou4, bu4 neng2 yi2 xia4 zi5 quan2 luan4 le5.
sentences.meaningKo: 초보자는 일을 할 때 더욱 단계를 중시해야지 한꺼번에 전부 엉망이 되면 안 된다.
sentences.meaningEn: Beginners especially need to emphasize steps in doing things and must not let everything become chaotic at once.

meaningEn: the division of work is clear

sentences.hanzi: 只要作业分工清楚，团队合作就会顺得多。
sentences.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 zuo4 ye4 fen1 gong1 qing1 chu3, tuan2 dui4 he2 zuo4 jiu4 hui4 shun4 de5 duo1.
sentences.meaningKo: 작업 분담만 분명하면 팀 협력은 훨씬 더 순조로워진다.
sentences.meaningEn: As long as the division of work is clear, teamwork will go much more smoothly.

meaningEn: to sit and wait until the teacher finishes arranging things

sentences.hanzi: 大家先坐着等老师安排完，再开始分组活动。
sentences.pinyin: da4 jia1 xian1 zuo4 zhe5 deng3 lao3 shi1 an1 pai2 wan2, zai4 kai1 shi3 fen1 zu3 huo2 dong4.
sentences.meaningKo: 모두 먼저 앉아서 선생님 배치가 끝나기를 기다린 뒤 조별 활동을 시작하자.
sentences.meaningEn: Everyone should first sit and wait until the teacher finishes arranging things, and then begin the group activity.

meaningEn: the group leader assigns tasks in a unified way

sentences.hanzi: 开会以后，先由组长统一分配任务。
sentences.pinyin: kai1 hui4 yi3 hou4, xian1 you2 zu3 zhang3 tong3 yi1 fen1 pei4 ren4 wu5.
sentences.meaningKo: 회의가 끝난 뒤 먼저 조장이 임무를 통일적으로 분배한다.
sentences.meaningEn: After the meeting, the group leader first assigns tasks in a unified way.

meaningEn: to be very rhythmic/steady in doing things

sentences.hanzi: 他做事很有节奏，所以一整天都不显得慌乱。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zuo4 shi4 hen3 you3 jie2 zou4, suo3 yi3 yi4 zheng3 tian1 dou1 bu4 xian3 de5 huang1 luan4.
sentences.meaningKo: 그는 일할 때 매우 리듬감이 있어서 하루 종일 허둥대 보이지 않는다.
sentences.meaningEn: He is very steady in doing things, so he does not look flustered all day.

meaningEn: the answer content is clear

sentences.hanzi: 只要作答内容清楚，阅卷人就不会误解你的意思。
sentences.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 zuo4 da2 nei4 rong2 qing1 chu3, yue4 juan4 ren2 jiu4 bu2 hui4 wu4 jie3 ni3 de5 yi4 si5.
sentences.meaningKo: 답안 내용만 분명하면 채점자가 네 뜻을 오해하지 않는다.
sentences.meaningEn: As long as the answer content is clear, the grader will not misunderstand your meaning.

meaningEn: the composition has clearly defined sections

sentences.hanzi: 这首作品作曲段落分明，整体结构非常清楚。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 shou3 zuo4 pin3 zuo4 qu3 duan4 luo4 fen1 ming2, zheng3 ti3 jie2 gou4 fei1 chang2 qing1 chu3.
sentences.meaningKo: 이 작품은 작곡 단락이 분명해서 전체 구조가 매우 명확하다.
sentences.meaningEn: This piece has clearly defined sections, making its overall structure very clear.

meaningEn: to sit and listen to task arrangements

sentences.hanzi: 大家先坐着听任务安排，听清楚以后再分头去做。

sentences.meaningKo: 모두 먼저 앉아서 임무 배치를 듣고 분명히 이해한 뒤 나누어 하러 가자.
sentences.meaningEn: Everyone should first sit and listen to the task arrangements, and split up to do them after understanding clearly.

meaningEn: the group leader explains the matters needing attention

sentences.hanzi: 开始之前，组长先说明了注意事项。
sentences.pinyin: kai1 shi3 zhi1 qian2, zu3 zhang3 xian1 shuo1 ming2 le5 zhu4 yi4 shi4 xiang4.
sentences.meaningKo: 시작하기 전에 조장이 먼저 주의 사항을 설명했다.
sentences.meaningEn: Before starting, the group leader first explained the matters needing attention.

meaningEn: to be logical in doing things

sentences.hanzi: 他做事很有逻辑性，所以分析问题特别透彻。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zuo4 shi4 hen3 you3 luo2 ji2 xing4, suo3 yi3 fen1 xi1 wen4 ti2 te4 bie2 tou4 che4.
sentences.meaningKo: 그는 일할 때 논리성이 있어서 문제를 분석할 때 특히 철저하다.
sentences.meaningEn: He is very logical in doing things, so his analysis of problems is especially thorough.

meaningEn: the work steps are clear

sentences.hanzi: 只要作业步骤清楚，后面培训新人也会省事很多。
sentences.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 zuo4 ye4 bu4 zhou4 qing1 chu3, hou4 mian4 pei2 xun4 xin1 ren2 ye3 hui4 sheng3 shi4 hen3 duo1.
sentences.meaningKo: 작업 단계만 분명하면 이후 신입 교육도 훨씬 수월해진다.
sentences.meaningEn: As long as the work steps are clear, training newcomers later will also become much easier.

meaningEn: to sit and listen until the teacher finishes speaking

sentences.hanzi: 大家先坐着听完老师讲，再开始练习。
sentences.pinyin: da4 jia1 xian1 zuo4 zhe5 ting1 wan2 lao3 shi1 jiang3, zai4 kai1 shi3 lian4 xi2.
sentences.meaningKo: 모두 먼저 앉아서 선생님 말씀을 끝까지 듣고 그다음 연습을 시작하자.
sentences.meaningEn: Everyone should first sit and listen until the teacher finishes speaking, and then begin practicing.

meaningEn: the group leader arranges the division of labor in a unified way

sentences.hanzi: 为了提高效率，这次由组长统一安排分工。
sentences.pinyin: wei4 le5 ti2 gao1 xiao4 lv4, zhe4 ci4 you2 zu3 zhang3 tong3 yi1 an1 pai2 fen1 gong1.
sentences.meaningKo: 효율을 높이기 위해 이번에는 조장이 역할 분담을 통일적으로 배치한다.
sentences.meaningEn: To improve efficiency, this time the group leader arranges the division of labor in a unified way.

meaningEn: to have execution steps in doing things

sentences.hanzi: 做事有执行步骤，团队配合起来就更容易。
sentences.pinyin: zuo4 shi4 you3 zhi2 xing2 bu4 zhou4, tuan2 dui4 pei4 he2 qi3 lai2 jiu4 geng4 rong2 yi4.
sentences.meaningKo: 일할 때 실행 단계가 있으면 팀이 협력하기가 더 쉬워진다.
sentences.meaningEn: When there are execution steps in doing things, it becomes easier for the team to cooperate.

meaningEn: the work instructions are clear

sentences.hanzi: 只要作业说明清楚，执行的人就不会理解错。
sentences.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 zuo4 ye4 shuo1 ming2 qing1 chu3, zhi2 xing2 de5 ren2 jiu4 bu2 hui4 li3 jie3 cuo4.
sentences.meaningKo: 작업 설명만 분명하면 실행하는 사람이 잘못 이해하지 않는다.
sentences.meaningEn: As long as the work instructions are clear, the people carrying them out will not misunderstand.

meaningEn: to sit and wait for the unified notice

sentences.hanzi: 大家先坐着等统一通知，不要各自去问。
sentences.pinyin: da4 jia1 xian1 zuo4 zhe5 deng3 tong3 yi1 tong1 zhi1, bu2 yao4 ge4 zi4 qu4 wen4.
sentences.meaningKo: 모두 먼저 앉아서 통일 공지를 기다리고 각자 따로 물으러 가지 마라.
sentences.meaningEn: Everyone should first sit and wait for the unified notice, and not go ask separately.

meaningEn: the group leader explains the overall arrangement

sentences.hanzi: 开始之前，组长先说明整体安排。
sentences.pinyin: kai1 shi3 zhi1 qian2, zu3 zhang3 xian1 shuo1 ming2 zheng3 ti3 an1 pai2.
sentences.meaningKo: 시작하기 전에 조장이 먼저 전체 배치를 설명한다.
sentences.meaningEn: Before starting, the group leader first explains the overall arrangement.

meaningEn: to have a clear line of thinking in doing things
meaningKo: 일할 때 분명한 사고 흐름이 있다

sentences.hanzi: 他做事有清晰思路，所以总能很快抓住重点。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zuo4 shi4 you3 qing1 xi1 si1 lu4, suo3 yi3 zong3 neng2 hen3 kuai4 zhua1 zhu4 zhong4 dian3.
sentences.meaningKo: 그는 일할 때 분명한 사고 흐름이 있어서 늘 아주 빨리 핵심을 파악할 수 있다.
sentences.meaningEn: He has a clear line of thinking in doing things, so he can always grasp the key points quickly.

meaningEn: the work requirements are clearly distinguished

sentences.hanzi: 只要作业要求分明，执行的人就知道轻重缓急。
sentences.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 zuo4 ye4 yao1 qiu2 fen1 ming2, zhi2 xing2 de5 ren2 jiu4 zhi1 dao4 qing1 zhong4 huan3 ji2.
sentences.meaningKo: 작업 요구 사항만 분명하면 실행하는 사람이 경중과 완급을 알게 된다.
sentences.meaningEn: As long as the work requirements are clearly distinguished, the people carrying them out will know the priorities and urgency.

meaningEn: to sit and wait for execution arrangements

sentences.hanzi: 大家先坐着等执行安排，不要着急分头行动。
sentences.pinyin: da4 jia1 xian1 zuo4 zhe5 deng3 zhi2 xing2 an1 pai2, bu2 yao4 zhao2 ji2 fen1 tou2 xing2 dong4.
sentences.meaningKo: 모두 먼저 앉아서 실행 배치를 기다리고 서둘러 흩어져 행동하지 마라.
sentences.meaningEn: Everyone should first sit and wait for the execution arrangements, and not hurry off to act separately.

meaningEn: the group leader assigns tasks in a unified way

sentences.hanzi: 为了减少混乱，这次由组长统一布置任务。
sentences.pinyin: wei4 le5 jian3 shao3 hun4 luan4, zhe4 ci4 you2 zu3 zhang3 tong3 yi1 bu4 zhi4 ren4 wu5.
sentences.meaningKo: 혼란을 줄이기 위해 이번에는 조장이 통일적으로 임무를 배치한다.
sentences.meaningEn: To reduce confusion, this time the group leader assigns tasks in a unified way.

meaningEn: to be well-planned in doing things

sentences.hanzi: 她做事有规划性，所以长期项目也能推进得很稳。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zuo4 shi4 you3 gui1 hua4 xing4, suo3 yi3 chang2 qi1 xiang4 mu4 ye3 neng2 tui1 jin4 de5 hen3 wen3.
sentences.meaningKo: 그녀는 일할 때 기획성이 있어서 장기 프로젝트도 매우 안정적으로 추진할 수 있다.
sentences.meaningEn: She is well-planned in doing things, so even long-term projects can be advanced very steadily.

meaningEn: the work requirements are stable and clear

sentences.hanzi: 只要作业要求稳定清楚，团队执行起来就更有信心。
sentences.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 zuo4 ye4 yao1 qiu2 wen3 ding4 qing1 chu3, tuan2 dui4 zhi2 xing2 qi3 lai2 jiu4 geng4 you3 xin4 xin1.
sentences.meaningKo: 작업 요구 사항만 안정적이고 분명하면 팀은 실행할 때 더 자신감을 갖게 된다.
sentences.meaningEn: As long as the work requirements are stable and clear, the team will carry them out with more confidence.

meaningEn: to sit and wait for the next notice

sentences.hanzi: 大家先坐着等下一项通知，不要随便离开座位。
sentences.pinyin: da4 jia1 xian1 zuo4 zhe5 deng3 xia4 yi2 xiang4 tong1 zhi1, bu2 yao4 sui2 bian4 li2 kai1 zuo4 wei4.
sentences.meaningKo: 모두 먼저 앉아서 다음 공지를 기다리고 함부로 자리를 떠나지 마라.
sentences.meaningEn: Everyone should first sit and wait for the next notice, and not leave their seats casually.

meaningEn: the group leader's arrangements are in perfect order

sentences.hanzi: 这次活动能顺利进行，是因为组长安排得井井有条。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 ci4 huo2 dong4 neng2 shun4 li4 jin4 xing2, shi4 yin1 wei4 zu3 zhang3 an1 pai2 de5 jing3 jing3 you3 tiao2.
sentences.meaningKo: 이번 활동이 순조롭게 진행될 수 있었던 것은 조장의 배치가 매우 정연했기 때문이다.
sentences.meaningEn: The reason this activity could proceed smoothly is that the group leader’s arrangements were perfectly orderly.

meaningEn: the work framework is clear

sentences.hanzi: 只要作业框架清楚，后面的细化工作就容易展开。
sentences.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 zuo4 ye4 kuang4 jia4 qing1 chu3, hou4 mian4 de5 xi4 hua4 gong1 zuo4 jiu4 rong2 yi4 zhan3 kai1.
sentences.meaningKo: 작업 틀만 분명하면 뒤의 세부화 작업도 쉽게 전개된다.
sentences.meaningEn: As long as the work framework is clear, the later detailed work can be developed easily.

meaningEn: after drawing a conclusion

sentences.hanzi: 做出结论后，大家很快就统一了行动方向。
sentences.pinyin: zuo4 chu1 jie2 lun4 hou4, da4 jia1 hen3 kuai4 jiu4 tong3 yi1 le5 xing2 dong4 fang1 xiang4.
sentences.meaningKo: 결론을 내린 뒤 모두가 아주 빨리 행동 방향을 통일했다.
sentences.meaningEn: After drawing a conclusion, everyone quickly unified their direction of action.

meaningEn: team members exchange opinions

sentences.hanzi: 在确定方案之前，组员先交换了一轮意见。
sentences.pinyin: zai4 que4 ding4 fang1 an4 zhi1 qian2, zu3 yuan2 xian1 jiao1 huan4 le5 yi4 lun2 yi4 jian4.
sentences.meaningKo: 방안을 확정하기 전에 조원들은 먼저 한 차례 의견을 교환했다.
sentences.meaningEn: Before finalizing the plan, the team members first exchanged a round of opinions.

meaningEn: to sit in the classroom

sentences.hanzi: 大家都安静地坐在教室里，等老师开始上课。
sentences.pinyin: da4 jia1 dou1 an1 jing4 di5 zuo4 zai4 jiao4 shi4 li3, deng3 lao3 shi1 kai1 shi3 shang4 ke4.
sentences.meaningKo: 모두 조용히 교실에 앉아 선생님이 수업을 시작하기를 기다렸다.
sentences.meaningEn: Everyone sat quietly in the classroom, waiting for the teacher to begin class.

meaningEn: the compositional thinking is clear

sentences.hanzi: 他的作曲思路清晰，所以作品听起来很完整。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 de5 zuo4 qu3 si1 lu4 qing1 xi1, suo3 yi3 zuo4 pin3 ting1 qi3 lai2 hen3 wan2 zheng3.
sentences.meaningKo: 그의 작곡 사고 흐름은 명확해서 작품이 들을 때 매우 완전하게 느껴진다.
sentences.meaningEn: His compositional thinking is clear, so the piece sounds very complete.

meaningEn: to pay attention to order and priority in doing things

sentences.hanzi: 做事要讲先后，不能什么都同时推进。
sentences.pinyin: zuo4 shi4 yao4 jiang3 xian1 hou4, bu4 neng2 shen2 me5 dou1 tong2 shi2 tui1 jin4.
sentences.meaningKo: 일할 때는 선후를 중시해야지 모든 것을 동시에 밀어붙여서는 안 된다.
sentences.meaningEn: When doing things, one must pay attention to order and priority, and cannot push everything forward at the same time.

sentences.meaningKo: 모두 먼저 앉아서 통일 지시를 기다리고 스스로 어떻게 할지 결정하지 마라.
sentences.meaningEn: Everyone should first sit and wait for the unified instructions, and not decide on their own what to do.

meaningEn: the group leader arranges the order in a unified way

sentences.hanzi: 为了减少冲突，由组长统一安排顺序最合适。
sentences.pinyin: wei4 le5 jian3 shao3 chong1 tu1, you2 zu3 zhang3 tong3 yi1 an1 pai2 shun4 xu4 zui4 he2 shi4.
sentences.meaningKo: 충돌을 줄이기 위해서는 조장이 순서를 통일적으로 배치하는 것이 가장 적절하다.
sentences.meaningEn: To reduce conflicts, it is most appropriate for the group leader to arrange the order in a unified way.

meaningEn: to have clear principles in doing things

sentences.hanzi: 做事有清楚原则，面对变化时也不容易动摇。
sentences.pinyin: zuo4 shi4 you3 qing1 chu3 yuan2 ze2, mian4 dui4 bian4 hua4 shi2 ye3 bu4 rong2 yi4 dong4 yao2.
sentences.meaningKo: 일할 때 분명한 원칙이 있으면 변화에 직면해도 쉽게 흔들리지 않는다.
sentences.meaningEn: When there are clear principles in doing things, one is not easily shaken even when facing changes.

meaningEn: the work arrangement is complete and specific

sentences.hanzi: 只要作业安排完整具体，后面执行就更顺利。
sentences.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 zuo4 ye4 an1 pai2 wan2 zheng3 ju4 ti3, hou4 mian4 zhi2 xing2 jiu4 geng4 shun4 li4.
sentences.meaningKo: 작업 배치만 완전하고 구체적이면 이후 실행이 더 순조롭다.
sentences.meaningEn: As long as the work arrangement is complete and specific, later execution will be smoother.

meaningEn: to sit and wait until it is explained clearly

sentences.hanzi: 大家先坐着等讲明白，再按要求去做。
sentences.pinyin: da4 jia1 xian1 zuo4 zhe5 deng3 jiang3 ming2 bai2, zai4 an4 yao1 qiu2 qu4 zuo4.
sentences.meaningKo: 모두 먼저 앉아서 알기 쉽게 설명되기를 기다린 뒤 요구에 따라 하자.
sentences.meaningEn: Everyone should first sit and wait until it is explained clearly, and then do it according to the requirements.

meaningEn: the group leader arranges the key requirements

sentences.hanzi: 开始前，组长先把要求重点安排清楚。
sentences.pinyin: kai1 shi3 qian2, zu3 zhang3 xian1 ba3 yao1 qiu2 zhong4 dian3 an1 pai2 qing1 chu3.
sentences.meaningKo: 시작 전에 조장이 먼저 요구 사항의 핵심을 분명히 배치해 둔다.
sentences.meaningEn: Before starting, the group leader first arranges the key requirements clearly.

meaningEn: to have clear requirements in doing things
meaningKo: 일할 때 명확한 요구 사항이 있다

sentences.hanzi: 做事有明确要求，团队执行时就不容易偏离标准。
sentences.pinyin: zuo4 shi4 you3 ming2 que4 yao1 qiu2, tuan2 dui4 zhi2 xing2 shi2 jiu4 bu2 rong2 yi4 pian1 li2 biao1 zhun3.
sentences.meaningKo: 일할 때 명확한 요구 사항이 있으면 팀이 실행할 때 기준에서 벗어나기 어렵다.
sentences.meaningEn: When there are clear requirements in doing things, the team is less likely to deviate from the standards during execution.

meaningEn: the work framework is clear and specific

sentences.hanzi: 只要作业框架明确具体，后面的细化就更容易展开。
sentences.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 zuo4 ye4 kuang4 jia4 ming2 que4 ju4 ti3, hou4 mian4 de5 xi4 hua4 jiu4 geng4 rong2 yi4 zhan3 kai1.
sentences.meaningKo: 작업 틀만 명확하고 구체적이면 이후 세부화가 더 쉽게 전개된다.
sentences.meaningEn: As long as the work framework is clear and specific, the later detailing can be developed more easily.

meaningEn: to sit and wait for the teacher's unified arrangements

sentences.hanzi: 大家先坐着等老师统一安排，再开始操作。
sentences.pinyin: da4 jia1 xian1 zuo4 zhe5 deng3 lao3 shi1 tong3 yi1 an1 pai2, zai4 kai1 shi3 cao1 zuo4.
sentences.meaningKo: 모두 먼저 앉아서 선생님의 통일 배치를 기다린 뒤 조작을 시작하자.
sentences.meaningEn: Everyone should first sit and wait for the teacher’s unified arrangements, and then begin operating.

hanzi: 组长统一安排任务重点
meaningEn: the group leader arranges the task priorities in a unified way

sentences.hanzi: 为了减少反复修改，由组长统一安排任务重点。
sentences.pinyin: wei4 le5 jian3 shao3 fan3 fu4 xiu1 gai3, you2 zu3 zhang3 tong3 yi1 an1 pai2 ren4 wu5 zhong4 dian3.
sentences.meaningKo: 반복 수정을 줄이기 위해 조장이 임무 중점을 통일적으로 배치한다.
sentences.meaningEn: To reduce repeated revisions, the group leader arranges the task priorities in a unified way.

meaningEn: to have clear priorities in doing things

sentences.hanzi: 做事有明确重点，推进时就不容易顾此失彼。
sentences.pinyin: zuo4 shi4 you3 ming2 que4 zhong4 dian3, tui1 jin4 shi2 jiu4 bu2 rong2 yi4 gu4 ci3 shi1 bi3.
sentences.meaningKo: 일할 때 명확한 중점이 있으면 추진할 때 한쪽만 챙기고 다른 쪽을 놓치기 어렵다.
sentences.meaningEn: When there are clear priorities in doing things, it is less likely to neglect one thing while focusing on another during progress.

meaningEn: the work steps are clear and specific

sentences.hanzi: 只要作业步骤明确具体，后面培训新人就更容易。
sentences.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 zuo4 ye4 bu4 zhou4 ming2 que4 ju4 ti3, hou4 mian4 pei2 xun4 xin1 ren2 jiu4 geng4 rong2 yi4.
sentences.meaningKo: 작업 단계만 명확하고 구체적이면 이후 신입 교육도 더 쉬워진다.
sentences.meaningEn: As long as the work steps are clear and specific, later training of newcomers becomes easier.

meaningEn: to sit and wait until the arrangement explanation is finished

sentences.hanzi: 大家先坐着等安排说明完，再按顺序开始。
sentences.pinyin: da4 jia1 xian1 zuo4 zhe5 deng3 an1 pai2 shuo1 ming2 wan2, zai4 an4 shun4 xu4 kai1 shi3.
sentences.meaningKo: 모두 먼저 앉아서 배치 설명이 끝나기를 기다린 뒤 순서대로 시작하자.
sentences.meaningEn: Everyone should first sit and wait until the arrangement explanation is finished, and then begin in order.

meaningEn: the group leader's arrangements are extremely clear

sentences.hanzi: 这次合作能这么顺利，是因为组长安排得十分明确。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 ci4 he2 zuo4 neng2 zhe4 me5 shun4 li4, shi4 yin1 wei4 zu3 zhang3 an1 pai2 de5 shi2 fen1 ming2 que4.
sentences.meaningKo: 이번 협력이 이렇게 순조로울 수 있었던 것은 조장의 배치가 매우 명확했기 때문이다.
sentences.meaningEn: This cooperation could go so smoothly because the group leader’s arrangements were extremely clear.
